answer_2.quote: We therefore use BEER as the utility of choice in our experiments and as a consequence will consistently report corpus-level BEER scores of MBR translations as well. We also report Sacre-BLEU scores where relevant to be able to detect overfitting to the utility and for comparison with other works.
